name: Wireless Earbuds — Touchscreen Charging Case
description: Wireless earbuds with stem buds and a charging case that has a built-in touchscreen showing battery level and controls. Comes in white and black.

source.notes: Style "A9pro (fake noise…)", ¥25.00. The supplier's own style name says the noise cancelling is fake: never claim ANC or noise cancelling, even though the case screen shows an ANC button. Owner raised the price to ₦12,000 because ₦7,000 was too thin. Rate 223.9 ₦/¥ (listing header). Shop confirmed as Huixun by the style picker. Owner set the price (₦12,000). Owner chose to keep it and accepts the lookalike risk. DO NOT claim ANC: the case screen shows an ANC button and Ambient Sound toggle but ANC is unverified. Design closely copies a well-known premium brand pro earbud and case, the white one closest: lookalike risk. Photos 800 px (black) and 1000 px (white) square, padded; black is soft. Screen UI text is English and is part of the product. Not a duplicate of the store earbuds. Lithium battery: sea freight only. Owner sent photos with no message; shop, listing, style name and ¥ price unknown. Likely the Shenzhen Huixun listing (offerId 1025659251706, 58.6% return rate) but unconfirmed: if so, samples first and stay unpublished. No Bluetooth version, battery, playtime or waterproofing claimed.

supplier.name: Shenzhen Huixun Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
